vol_rle_union — 3D rle_region op

• Data kinds: rle_region × rle_region → rle_region

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.vol_rle_union(a, b) (to call the implementation directly, import volregion; volregion.vol_rle_union(a, b); from the registry, ops3d.get("vol_rle_union"))

Usage

Union of two RLE regions, computed on the runs (no decode). Cost scales

with the run counts, not the voxel counts — merging two 512**3 masks never touches 512**3 anything. Regions must share the same volume shape.

Procedure (shared _rle_boolean): the runs of both regions are mapped onto 1 integer line with a stride of W + 1 per plane row (the +1 gap keeps runs of neighbouring rows from joining), each run's start/end is listed as an event, and the per-interval coverage state (inside a, inside b) is swept, regrouping the intervals where ia | ib is true into maximal-length runs. The cost is O(n log n) in the number of runs n (the sort in np.unique).

Returns: a new VolRLE with the same shape (runs in row order, ascending x, adjacent and overlapping runs already merged into 1). If both are empty, a region with 0 runs. vol_rle_decode(union) == decode(a) | decode(b) holds voxel by voxel.

Validation (ValueError): either one is not a VolRLE or fails the consistency check / a.shape != b.shape (regions living in different volumes cannot be combined).
